boundary_non_bypassable.title: Boundary Non-Bypassable
boundary_non_bypassable.description: Attestation: no alternate network path lets DMZ/presentation reach the data tier skipping the app boundary's authn/authz/audit.

dmz_to_data_tier_path_exists.title: DMZ-to-Data-Tier Path Exists
dmz_to_data_tier_path_exists.description: Attestation: a direct DMZ-to-data-tier network path has been discovered or is known to exist.

internal_interface_reauthenticates_calls.title: Internal Interface Re-Authenticates Calls
internal_interface_reauthenticates_calls.description: Attestation: the app-tier boundary re-authenticates every ingress call at its internal interface (per-request authn via mTLS/SVID or OIDC/JWT at a PEP) rather than implicitly trusting presentation-tier calls.

server_side_allowlist_validation.title: Server-Side Allow-List Validation
server_side_allowlist_validation.description: Attestation: untrusted input crossing the app boundary is validated server-side using allow-lists (anchored regex/schema/WAF/OpenAPI), not client-side only.

identity_propagated_cryptographically.title: Identity Propagated Cryptographically
identity_propagated_cryptographically.description: Attestation: caller identity crosses the internal boundary in a cryptographically verifiable form (gateway-signed JWT iss/aud/exp/sig, mTLS cert subject, SPIFFE SVID) - NOT unsigned X-User-Id headers or IP allow-lists.

shared_service_credentials_used.title: Shared Service Credentials Used
shared_service_credentials_used.description: Attestation: presentation tier authenticates to app tier using a shared service account / static service token reused across all end-user sessions (collapsing per-user identity into one principal).

east_west_microsegmentation_enforced.title: East-West Microsegmentation Enforced
east_west_microsegmentation_enforced.description: Attestation: lateral movement within the app tier is constrained by default-deny NetworkPolicy / service-mesh / SG-to-SG allow-lists per service pair and port.

service_to_service_mtls_enforced.title: Service-to-Service mTLS Enforced
service_to_service_mtls_enforced.description: Attestation: east-west service-to-service calls inside the app tier require their own cryptographic peer authn (strict mTLS / SPIFFE SVID / workload-identity tokens).

mfa_enforced_at_boundary_crossing.title: MFA Enforced at Boundary Crossing
mfa_enforced_at_boundary_crossing.description: Attestation: every human-principal session crossing into the app boundary is challenged for MFA at ingress (FIDO2 preferred).

least_privilege_authorization_at_crossin.title: Least-Privilege Authorization at Crossing
least_privilege_authorization_at_crossin.description: Attestation: per-request authz at the boundary is least-privilege (default-deny, no wildcard scopes, admin actions gated behind a separately-scoped role).

app_tier_egress_destination_allowlisted.title: App-Tier Egress Destination Allow-Listed
app_tier_egress_destination_allowlisted.description: Attestation: outbound traffic from app-tier workloads is constrained to an allow-list (data-tier endpoints, KMS, observability, package mirrors). General 0.0.0.0/0 internet egress is blocked or forced through an inspecting proxy.

cloud_metadata_endpoint_blocked.title: Cloud Metadata Endpoint Blocked
cloud_metadata_endpoint_blocked.description: Attestation: cloud IMDS (169.254.169.254 / GCP / Azure equivalents) is unreachable from app workloads OR only reachable behind IMDSv2-style session-token+hop-limit constraints that an SSRF cannot satisfy.

back_end_traffic_reencrypted_after_tls_t.title: Back-End Traffic Re-Encrypted After TLS Termination
back_end_traffic_reencrypted_after_tls_t.description: Attestation: after edge TLS termination, traffic onward to app/data tiers is re-encrypted (TLS to upstreams w/ upstream cert verification OR strict mTLS via mesh) rather than plaintext on the back end.

management_plane_isolated_from_data_plan.title: Management Plane Isolated from Data Plane
management_plane_isolated_from_data_plan.description: Attestation: admin/management interfaces of the boundary itself (gateway admin, mesh control plane, firewall mgmt) are NOT reachable from user-traffic networks - separate admin segment / mgmt VPN / IP-allowlisted admin tier.

boundary_admin_actions_require_mfa_and_a.title: Boundary Admin Actions Require MFA and Are Audited
boundary_admin_actions_require_mfa_and_a.description: Attestation: privileged actions on the boundary's management plane require MFA AND every change is recorded to a tamper-resistant off-box audit log.
